senses.gloss:
धौत, अस्, आ, अम्, cleansed, &c. See p. 460,
col. 2.

धौत धौत, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 2. धाव्),
washed, cleansed, cleaned, purified, washed off;
polished, brightened, whetted; white, bright, silvered,
shining; (अम्), n. silver.
—धौत-कट, अस्, m. a
bag of coarse cloth, a sack made of kind of mat-
ting.
—धौत-कोषज or धौत-कौषेय or
धौत-कौशेय, अम्, n. bleached or purified silk
(= पत्त्रोर्ण).
—धौत-खण्डी, f. sugar-candy.
—धौत-बली, f. = धौताञ्जली, (probably rather
धौताञ्जनी, q. v.)
—धौत-मूलक, अस्, m., N.
of a prince of the Cīnas.
—धौत-शिल, अम्, n.
‘bright stone,’ crystal, rock-crystal.
—धौताञ्जनी,
f. a sort of collyrium, = त्र्यङ्कट or त्र्यङ्गट.
—धौतापाङ्ग, अस्, आ, अम्, having the corners of
the eyes brightened.

धौतय धौतय, अस् or अम्, m. or n. (?), a
kind of salt (= सैन्धव).

धौतरी धौतरी, f. (fr. rt. 1. धू), Ved.
(according to Sāy.) shaking, agitating, causing to
tremble.

धौति धौति, इस्, f. (fr. rt. 1. धाव्), Ved. a
spring, well; river, rivulet.
